output_encoding.description: Decode stage that produced the tool output (GAP-ENCODING-GATE, OPS-PROTOCOL §8): utf-8 / utf-8-sig / gb18030 / utf-8-lossy, comma-joined for multi-chunk streams.

candidate_count.description: FUS-RETRIEVAL-MECH P0-B step 2 (2026-08-14): the per-activation deduplicated web_fetch candidate count after this call (or at refusal). Present only on web_fetch-family tool_completed events; pairing/range/error-shape rules are enforced by the Python cross-layer verifier (_verify_v02_web_fetch_candidate_count), keeping the schema shape minimal.

candidate_cap.description: FUS-RETRIEVAL-MECH P0-B step 2 (2026-08-14): the web_fetch candidate cap in effect (ORZ_WEB_FETCH_CANDIDATE_CAP, default 8). Present together with candidate_count.
